title: Finance Operator
subtitle: A 30-day AI operator pass for budgeting discipline, cash planning, reporting structure, and decision-ready finance workflows.
descriptionBody:
Founders rarely struggle because numbers do not exist. They struggle because the numbers live in scattered sheets, partial assumptions, and irregular reporting rhythms that make every decision slower than it should be.

Finance Operator acts like an operating layer around finance work. The pass gives founders and small teams 30 days of access plus included shared-wallet credits to structure cash planning, forecast updates, reporting views, and finance questions into a rhythm that supports real decisions.
section1Title: A finance operator for the in-between stage
section1Body: Not every startup is ready for a full finance hire, but every startup still needs cleaner budgeting, forecast updates, runway visibility, and sharper decision support. Finance Operator is aimed at that middle zone where the business needs more rigor before it can justify a dedicated finance seat.

features.name: Budget and runway framing
features.desc: Organizes expense logic, cash priorities, and runway assumptions into a clearer operating view.

features.name: Forecast update workflows
features.desc: Supports recurring forecast refreshes so the model does not go stale after one planning session.

features.name: Reporting and review structure
features.desc: Turns raw finance data into practical summaries for founders, operators, or investor updates.

features.name: Decision support prompts
features.desc: Helps teams reason through tradeoffs around hiring, spend, pricing, and cash timing with more discipline.

whyTitle: Why use this before hiring finance?

whyPoints.title: Brings rigor earlier
whyPoints.desc: You do not need to wait for a full finance team to introduce better reporting and planning habits.

whyPoints.title: Improves operating conversations
whyPoints.desc: Cleaner finance structure leads to faster decisions around burn, priorities, and resource allocation.

whyPoints.title: Compatible with Telegram and shared top-ups
whyPoints.desc: The pass fits the Founder Systems Telegram flow and shared top-up wallet, so finance usage does not live in a separate silo.

footerSummaryDetails: for a 30-day access pass with 750 included shared-wallet credits.
footerResultDetails: A tighter finance rhythm with better visibility into runway, budget tradeoffs, and recurring reporting decisions.
whatYouGet: Decision support for spend and hiring tradeoffs
whoThisIsFor: Founders running finance reviews without a dedicated finance lead.
COOs, chiefs of staff, or generalist operators covering budget coordination.
Teams that need better runway and reporting discipline.
Startups preparing for more investor or board-level finance scrutiny.

faq.q: Does this replace a financial model?
faq.a: No. It complements finance artifacts by helping the team operate around them with better planning and reporting structure.
Finance Operator is sold as a 30-day access pass with included credits rather than a one-time lifetime purchase.
V1 keeps sensitive finance writes approval-gated. It can structure and prepare work, and integrations can be added behind explicit approval policies.
